notes: Symbols are the published CI xMAPs; sizes and addresses describe the sha1-pinned retail ROMs.
HG==SS is asserted for every emitted symbol and gameplay site (menu_only_ov74 bytes may differ per title).

schema_notes.address: integers; address_hex is the same value for humans
schema_notes.collides_with: other images whose bytes share this address range: residency + byte checks are mandatory
schema_notes.evidence_classes: SOURCE (pinned source), FILE (pinned artifact bytes), OPEN (null + reason in `open`); nothing here is PHYSICAL
schema_notes.fire_hex: 8 hex digits: int.from_bytes(register_hex[:4],'little') — the callback's unsigned `val` word
schema_notes.hge_status: hge sites: KEPT = the extent bytes are identical to vanilla in the declared image (not a whole-function claim); REPLACED = vanilla entry clobbered, the site is the exported replacement; SOURCE_ONLY = address from hge source
schema_notes.image: arm9 (static main only) or ov<N>; sites are resolved from this image, never from the address alone
schema_notes.mode: thumb|arm from the xMAP $t/$a mapping symbol (hgss/pt) or the stub/linker evidence recorded in mode_evidence (hge)
schema_notes.overlays: ROM overlay table; size is the decompressed byte length, bss is separate
schema_notes.phases: candidate_sites are the G1 candidates; cap/target_max are the plan's per-phase budgets; armed_set is chosen at G2
schema_notes.register_hex: full extent bytes read from the declared image (extent = min(16, symbol size), >=4)

open.array_footer: SaveArrayFooter (per-array, include/save.h:28-34) location is not pinned; the chunk footer is the signature
open.battle_offsets_live_read: battle offsets are SOURCE/asm-literal derived; a live read is a G1/G3 cell
open.phase_first_event_coverage: PHYSICAL first/last-event coverage per phase belongs to C1-1/C1-8
open.slot_spec_runtime_values: slot offset/size values are read at runtime from saveSlotSpecs; measured HG FILE: general 0xF628, pc @0xF700 size 0x12310
open.soulsilver_save_offsets: no owner SS save (D4): party_off / trainer FILE evidence is HeartGold only

open: Task_Blackout hook only if the outcome latch cannot cover every loss path (PHYSICAL)
polled: encounter-scoped outcome latch (setup winFlag kept across copy-back/blackout)

arm_when_any.note: table observed one frame late; first battle event cannot precede residency
fs.taskman != NULL while an encounter task runs (setup before residency)

disarm_when_all.note: drain queued events before removing the registry
checkpoint: no encounter task, outcome latch cleared once

battle.armed_set_note: which candidates arm is fixed at G2 after producer coverage; G1 only needs the candidates
open: a raw HP write is not known to run the faint command (C1-8 owns the seam)
no producer proof that these sites cover every battle write path (C1-1/C1-8 PHYSICAL)
Save_WriteManFinish is a candidate only; save-driver polling is the target
polled: save settled via the save driver state

arm_when_any.note: launched app (fs.unk0->unk4 != NULL) or overlay predicate
catch store reaches PC placement from ov12
script/gift/daycare callers run under a field task

pc.armed_set_note: which candidates arm is fixed at G2 after caller coverage
open: PC UI action handlers not located (engine_sites.md Open); model functions assumed to cover them
static ARM9 sites: application/caller coverage predicates are PHYSICAL cells

probe.note: G1 probe only; never armed in production. Register at most 4 at once (D6 fps curve).
